fit.coach_and_team_rule: Average earlier matching team, coach, or coach-team observations with one training-league-mean observation for shrinkage; fall back to that mean.
fit.roster_rule: One straight line per feature using training seasons. Uses realized holdout roster features for a retrospective diagnostic; clips values to the training feature limits.

measurement_notes.assignments: Season-aggregated assignments, including initial matchups, switches and other changes. Effective FG% uses attributed field goal attempts. No intervention or hunt labels.
measurement_notes.bbi: Minutes-weighted private-research aggregates from the local Basketball Index input. Team summaries exclude multi-team players. Coverage aggression and help are indexes. Rim defended attempts and contested share are proxies for rim involvement.
measurement_notes.coach: Named head coach for single-coach seasons from the rotation research. Mixed seasons counted at team level with a null coach.
measurement_notes.screen_assists: Made baskets directly credited to a screen, divided by NBA advanced possessions. Players use on-court possessions across all their teams.
measurement_notes.synergy_qualifying_player_stints: NBA.com/Synergy player by team stints above the source's play-type minimum. Team aggregates omit unqualified stints. Plays ending in a shot, free throws or turnover, not all initiating actions.
